_about: H-tooth: brush, drill, fill, all inside one mouth close-up (1 Oct play-test D15d, decision 27; js/clinic/heal/games/tooth.js). Levels are data: levels[n].chain (brush moves, said one at a time), levels[n].decay (how many jagged patches and how big: scattered by level, CLN-52), levels[n].drillMs (a gentle timer), fill (the green zone and the fill time per level: narrower and faster, CLN-53). art: the close-up and props from the art plan (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md M1, O2, B1) swap in by file name once the cut session sets ready: true (and records the boxes). The words are data/clinic/lang.json's (tooth-*, cl-dabo / cl-jamno at level 3).

sugar-bug.story: a sugar bug from Arc 1's sweets

cracked-tooth.story: a sugar bug and a cracked tooth

_words: CLN-119: the words this game teaches (its word review, from the language engine: the game reads the engine, never this list). Listed so build/tools/review/heal-marks.mjs shows them; js/clinic/heal/colour-clips.test.mjs keeps it the engine's

1._note: two moves on the cross (up / down / left / right, one at a time, the screen's left and right); dirt only on the order's sides while its words are supported; one big patch; no timer

2._note: four moves on the cross; dirt only on the order's sides while its words are supported (stage 1-2); two patches

3._note: four moves, dirt on all four sides (listening wins); two patches

4._note: harder variety (level 4, Zafar 13 Oct): six moves; four small patches scattered; a gentle timer; the narrow green

fill._about: the gauge: 0 = empty, max = the top; let go inside zone[level] (green, red either side); ms = empty to full while the button is held

brush._about: the toothbrush picture and where its head is (the picture's own pixels)
brush._s11: Sprint 11: on the plus-shaped track the handle lies 45 degrees down to the right, between the right and down channels, so it never covers a target

drill._about: CLN-51: the drill's picture and where its tip (the bur) is in the picture's own pixels; the tip sits under the finger.

art._about: art plan pack clinic-heal-v3: each slot is used once ready is true ({kind} = the patient's kind); box = x, y, w, h in the close-up's 800x500 units; tip = the nozzle's tip in its own drawn size. Until then the game draws stand-ins.

mouth._a1: A1 (5 Oct): M1's upper teeth (centre 770, 312 in the 1536 x 1024 source, about 480 wide) on the game's upper row (centre 400, 171, 330 wide) at 0.69; the ears and plaits fall off screen, the cheeks fill the sides. The drill view stays drawn.
mouth._s02: S02-E (RM1, the redo: tighter framing, no ears or plaits): v2's upper teeth (centre 774, 335, about 570 wide) on the same upper row (centre 400, 173) at 0.58 (v1's box kept as box_v1)

glint._why: s10b: the pale rectangle baked into the sore tooth top of the mouth picture (and its upscaled teeth); patched with the surface 30 units below, feathered

mouth._s08: CLN-163 (clinic decision 7): ONE picture for the drill and the fill, the camera pushing in on its own sore tooth (js/clinic/heal/games/tooth.js). box: registered on the brushing mouth (mouthBrush) by the two front teeth (their gap at x 769 / 768.75 and their lower edge at y 422 / 372.5 in the two 1x sources; widths 106 / 95 px), so the change from one mouth to the other is the mouth opening; always2x: the @2x whatever the screen (the camera pushes in on it about 2-3x); teeth: the four front upper teeth [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the 1x source (measured on the @2x), the sore one of them; hd: the same teeth upscaled x2 from the @2x (Real-ESRGAN x2plus, build/tools/art/upscale.py's network and weights, run in numpy: 1680 x 680), laid exactly over its crop [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the 1x source. The s02 box is box_s02.

buttonUp._a2: A2 (5 Oct): B1's button, up and down on one canvas

nozzle._a2: A2 (5 Oct): B1's nozzle drawn 200 wide, its needle's tip (20, 301 in the 512 x 320 cut) on the hole

fillingPatch._a2: A2 (5 Oct): O2's white filling, laid inside each drilled patch's outline as the paste goes in

mouthBrush._s02: S02-E (M3, CLN-103): the mouth less open for the brushing (teeth a third of the mouth's height): its upper teeth (y about 398-450 of the 1536 x 1024 source, x 601-940) on the brushing row (the brush head at 400, 190) at 1.12. Shown for the brush step only; the drill and fill keep M1.

plaque._s02: S02-E (M4, T9): the plaque picture, registered to M3 (same box): drawn over it and wiped away where the brush goes (a mask), the last of it at the brushing's end

brushInMouth._s02: S02-E (E5b, CLN-103): the brusher's view of the toothbrush, level; up and down are the same brush tipped 30 degrees for an up or down stroke (their own canvases: up 471 x 220, down 472 x 194, the head at the left)
brushInMouth._s08: CLN-180 (Zafar, 18 Oct; s08b TB1): the brush lying level, the bristles at its left end against the front teeth (head = the bristles' middle, 1x px), the handle running out of the mouth to the right; no turn and no squash (brushTurn is gone), no tipped up/down pictures (the old brush's, kept as *_s02)

drillView.why: s07-clinic-a (TD1): the drill step's one sore tooth, big, with its neighbours and the gum (artcut.py s07.cut.json tooth-drill-view). Its crown (centre x 760, top 165, bottom 750 in the 1536 x 1024 source, at the middle) on the drawn tooth's place (centre 400, top 80, bottom 392) at one scale (0.533): the decay patches (CROWN) and the drill's reach (276-524 x 96-392) lie on its enamel
drillView._s08: CLN-163: no longer used: the drill happens on the mouth's own tooth (art.mouth), never a second picture

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
camera._target: A1 (5 Oct): the match cut. target = where the close-up draws the sore part and size = its radius, in the close-up's 800 x 500 units: the push-in ends with the patient's part (from the art's anchor) at that place and size.
camera._s08: CLN-163: the target on the brushing mouth's lips (the front teeth's lower edge is y 205.6 in the close-up's units), where the far view (view.farY) puts it, so the room's mouth and the close-up's meet in the one camera move
camera._mid: s08 wave 7B (CLN-163, Zafar 20 Oct: likeness yes): the zoom's middle step (js/clinic/heal/host.js HOST.stage, MID): GZ1, her face front-on saying aah (sources/art/s08c/gz1-girl-face-aah-v1.png, colour-corrected to her sheet's face #E39468; 1536 x 1024, no @2x), laid over the drawn girl in the room by its eyes' midpoint (783, 367) and mouth (779, 533) in the source as shares (eyes, mouth), dissolving in between 30% and 55% of the push-in; mask = the feathered ellipse kept (centre x, y, radii x, y as shares of the picture); lips = its lips' width (696-871 in the source) as a share of its width, lip = the close-up's lips' width at rest in its svg units (measured on the 1366x768 shot): after it is in it grows about its mouth a little faster than the room, so its lips meet the close-up's at the hand-over

_assets: Decision 68 (J11, S02-E): the pictures this game shows, loaded (warmed) when its patient is chosen (js/clinic/main.js loadGame) and held by build/tools/review/loadcheck.mjs; the clinic's shared ones are data/clinic/assets.json

view._about: CLN-163 (CLN-185: 'a little bit too zoomed in ... a bit intimidating'): the tooth's own camera (js/clinic/heal/games/tooth.js view). far: the brushing view, the scene's fit widened by 1/far, centred on y farY (svg units); near: the drill and fill view, the sore tooth 256 of `near` drill units wide (it was 256 of 800), its top nearTop of the view down; ms: the move in or out (one tween).

track._about: Sprint 11 (Zafar, 21 Oct): the plus-shaped brushing track, the mouth close-up's units: its centre (where the brush head rests) is the code's (x 400, y 190); ax / ay how far the channels run, w their width, r the targets' radius
